title: PHP application is reachable (index.php is served)
summary: GET /index.php returns a real page rather than the not found page, so a PHP front controller is served here.  This marks the site as a PHP runtime to track for patching.  It does not identify the PHP build or confirm any CVE.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.

reproduce: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://host/index.php  (200 means a PHP front controller is served here; a 404 means it is not)
remediate: This is an inventory signal, not a vulnerability.  If this PHP application is internet facing, make sure its PHP runtime is on a vendor patched release and the host is tracked in your patch inventory.
